name: photo-chromatic-abstraction-style-1
title_zh: 只留 1~5 个源图色，把照片译成色块记忆卡
tagline_zh: 照片信息太多？它只留色块和1-5个克制的高光点。适合色彩构成练习、色卡转译，或你只想记住画面的颜色而非细节时。
tagline_en: Too much detail in your photo? It keeps only flat color fields plus 1-5 restrained accents. For palette-memory.
desc_en: Translate an uploaded or local photograph into a color-first chromatic-memory abstraction (Style 1) built from adaptive flat fields and 1-5 restrained, source-derived accents. Use for palette-memory composition, color-weight studies, minimalist color-block translation, 色块抽象、照片色彩记忆、色彩构成、照片色卡转译，or explicit Style-1 requests where broad color hierarchy matters more than subject placement. Do not use w
why_zh: 自适应平场分区，不靠边缘检测或主体识别——颜色层级决定一切，高光点从原图推导而非随机点缀。
why_en: Adaptive flat-field segmentation, not edge detection or subject recognition—color hierarchy drives everything. Accents are.
limit_zh: 只做风格1的色块抽象，不做构图重构或细节保留。输入需为单张照片（本地或上传），不支持多图合成。产物为静态图。
limit_en: Only Style-1 color-block abstraction; no composition reshaping or detail retention. Single photo input only (local or upload), no multi-image.
title_en: Photo to 1–5-color memory blocks, not a copy
